outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Newly released 911 calls capture confusion after Christa Pike's botched execution; Accused Cornell University student asks for gag order; Archbishop of US military says Catholic soldiers should not serve on firing squad.

items.headline: Newly released 911 calls capture confusion after Christa Pike's botched execution
items.detail: One of Pike's attorneys also called 911 to report that Pike is "still alive and breathing, and needs immediate life-saving care," according to audio of the call.

items.headline: Accused Cornell University student asks for gag order
items.detail: Lawyers for an accused Cornell student have asked the judge for a gag order to prevent public comments about the case.

items.headline: Archbishop of US military says Catholic soldiers should not serve on firing squad
items.detail: The archbishop who oversees Catholic pastoral services for the U.S. military is condemning the proposed livestream of Nidal Hasan's firing squad execution

items.headline: WATCH: Michael Jordan's 1998 NBA Finals jersey sells for record $14 million
items.detail: A game-worn, autographed Michael Jordan jersey from the 1998 NBA finals sold for a record $14 million, second behind Babe Ruth's 1932 World Series jersey. David Muir reports.

items.headline: WATCH: Rams, Bills face off in Monday Night Football showdown
items.detail: NFL network reporter Cameron Wolfe previews the Rams, Bills matchup, featuring MVP quarterbacks Matthew Stafford and Josh Allen.
